sources.snippet: In addition, we analyze the incorporation of efficient attention into large-scale pre-trained language models, including both architectures built entirely on efficient attention and hybrid designs that combine local and global components.

sources.title: Efficient Attention Methods
sources.snippet: Recently, a plethora of methods have been proposed to improve the computational efficiency of the attention operation, which are very critical for developing large-scale models. In this paper, we present a unified taxonomy and a comprehensive survey of efficient attention methods.
